programme.desc: Um casal reformado recusa-se a aceitar o corte das suas reformas e reúne um grupo de amigos para lutar pelos direitos de todos. A estratégia é simples assaltar bancos.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 119
programme.desc: Uma visão cómica e provocadora dos tempos que vivemos, com o realizador Michael Moore a explorar as duas questões cruciais da Era Trump como diabo chegámos aqui e como diabo conseguiremos nós escapar.

programme.title: Interrogation - Explosões Em Cadeia
programme.desc: Quando o FBI recebe a ameaça de que uma bomba vai explodir na cidade, um interrogador e uma informática envolvem-se numa série de jogos mentais com um criminoso, lutando contra o tempo para desvendar os seus verdadeiros motivos e impedir o desastre.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoé
programme.desc: Numa pequena ilha paradisíaca, o papagaio Terça-feira e o seu grupo de animais amigos encontram o náufrago Robinson Crusoé. No início, o convívio não é fácil mas lentamente, todos começam a viver juntos em harmonia, pelo menos até dois gatos virem colocar tudo em risco.

programme.title: Dartagnan, O 4 Mosqueteiro
programme.desc: A pedido do seu pai, o jovem DArtagnan viaja da Gasconha rural para Paris para se tornar mosqueteiro e acaba envolvido numa conspiração do traidor Conde Rochefort contra o Rei Luís XIV, juntando-se aos três célebres mosqueteiros para deter os inimigos da coroa.

programme.title: Bowfinger - O Sem Vergonha
programme.desc: Bobby Bowfinger, produtor de filmes, há anos que tenta conseguir um êxito de bilheteira. O seu próximo filme terá tudo o que um grande sucesso precisa ação, alienígenas, uma bela jovem e Kit Ramsey, a maior estrela de Hollywood. Só há um senão o próprio Kit não sabe que foi escolhido para o papel.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: Mad Max Além Da Cúpula Do Trovão
programme.desc: Dois homens entram e só um sai é essa a lei da arena Thunderdome em Bartertown, a cidade perdida governada pela poderosa Aunty Entity. Quando Max é exilado de lá, encontra em pleno deserto uma comunidade isolada de crianças. Mas sobreviver continua a não ser mesmo nada fácil

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: O Diário De Uma Rapariga Adolescente
programme.desc: Minnie Goetze tem 15 anos, quer ser desenhadora de BD e está a crescer no ambiente frenético da São Francisco dos anos 70. É uma típica adolescente em quase tudo, exceto no facto de descobrir o sexo com o namorado da mãe, com quem acaba por manter uma relação, mesmo depois desta descobrir...

programme.title: Mad Max - As Motos Da Morte
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo e apocalíptico, Mad Max Rockatansky, um destemido polícia vestido de cabedal, declara guerra aos assassinos motorizados que apontaram armas à sua família.

programme.title: Elyse
programme.desc: Memória e alucinação entrelaçam-se na vida de Elyse, institucionalizada num hospital psiquiátrico, sob os cuidados do Dr. Lewis e com as consequências de um trauma profundo.

programme.title: Nós Que Ficámos
programme.desc: A vida pacata de Cami e da sua filha adolescente é virada do avesso com o falecimento repentino do pai da rapariga, cuja nova mulher e filha pequena ficam de repente sem lar nem rendimentos. Cami acolhe-as em sua casa só que não vai ser fácil juntar aquelas quatro figuras debaixo do mesmo teto.

programme.title: Viajantes Instinto E Desejo
programme.desc: Uma tripulação de astronautas numa missão multigeracional desenvolve sinais claros de paranoia e loucura, sem saber o que é real ou não.

programme.title: Spycies Agentes Especiais
programme.desc: O gato Vladimir é o melhor agente especial dos Serviços Secretos, mas não é bom a cumprir ordens... Como castigo é-lhe atribuída uma missão com um agente principiante, o rato Hector, e quando esta corre mal eles são forçados a juntarem esforços para se redimirem enquanto espiões e salvarem o mundo.

programme.title: Bowfinger - O Sem Vergonha
programme.desc: Bobby Bowfinger, produtor de filmes, há anos que tenta conseguir um êxito de bilheteira. O seu próximo filme terá tudo o que um grande sucesso precisa ação, alienígenas, uma bela jovem e Kit Ramsey, a maior estrela de Hollywood. Só há um senão o próprio Kit não sabe que foi escolhido para o papel.

programme.title: Novos Amigos Improváveis
programme.desc: Phillip é um homem rico e tetraplégico e Dell é um desempregado com cadastro criminal que é contratado para o ajudar. Apesar da relação inicial tensa, os dois acabam por forjar uma inesperada amizade, que mudará a via de ambos.

programme.title: Mad Max 2 - O Guerreiro Da Estrada
programme.desc: Num futuro devastado, o cada vez mais cínico e descrente Max aceita ajudar uma pequena comunidade com acesso a gasolina a livrar-se do grupo de guerreiros sanguinários que a quer eliminar.

programme.title: Mad Max Além Da Cúpula Do Trovão
programme.desc: Dois homens entram e só um sai é essa a lei da arena Thunderdome em Bartertown, a cidade perdida governada pela poderosa Aunty Entity. Quando Max é exilado de lá, encontra em pleno deserto uma comunidade isolada de crianças. Mas sobreviver continua a não ser mesmo nada fácil

programme.title: A Armadilha
programme.desc: Virginia Gin Baker é uma investigadora de uma empresa de seguros enviada para perseguir e ajudar a capturar Robert MacDougal, um ladrão profissional especializado em arte.

programme.title: A Força Em Alerta
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas toma de assalto um couraçado da marinha americana, a única pessoa capaz de os deter é um ex-Navy Seal que é atualmente o cozinheiro da embarcação.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Retaliação
programme.desc: Um ano após os acontecimentos de Kickboxer - A Vingança, Kurt Sloan jura nunca voltar à Tailândia. Mas acaba por ser forçado a regressar ao ser dopado e atirado para uma prisão. Para recuperar a liberdade, terá de enfrentar Mongkut, um verdadeiro gigante de 200kg e mais de dois metros de altura.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, “Titan”. Composed between 1887 and 1888, the symphony blends traditional form with innovative ideas like folk melodies, march rhythms, and fanfare motifs.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Giselle
programme.desc: Choreographed by Charles Jude, the ballet Giselle by Jean Coralli and Jules Perrot, with music by Adolphe Adam, tells the story of a lovely peasant girl by the same name. Giselle was first presented at Théâtre de l'Académie Royale de Musique in Salle Le Peletier in Paris on June 28, 1841. The story is set in the Rhineland of the Middle Ages during the grape harvest. Giselle falls in love with Albrecht, the Duke of Silesia.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Il modo di prender morale’ from Franz Schubert’s Drei Lieder, Op. 83, D. 902; ‘Le faune’ from Claude Debussy’s Fêtes galantes II, L. 114; ‘Du alte Ananasbirne’ from Miroslav Srnka’s Dreizehn Lieder; Alphons Diepenbrock’s Simeons lofzang, RC 120; Carl Loewe’s Odins Meeresritt, Op.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 3 BWV 1016
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach’s Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 3 BWV 1016 belongs to a group of sonatas composed before 1975, probably during the composer’s tenure as Kapellmeister at Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonata’s for Prince Leopold, later adapting them for his own purposes in Leipzig.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. As part of this concert, the ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by violinists Maxim Vengerov and Tedi Papavrami, cellist Mischa Maisky, and her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, Op. 16
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Schumann claimed that he penned this 1838 composition in just four days. He dedicated it to Frédéric Chopin, his contemporary.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous 'hammer' blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 7, nicknamed 'Song of the Night,' is a five-movement, entirely instrumental work composed during a more optimistic period, featuring unique orchestral colors from instruments like the mandolin, guitar, and euphonium. The work's unique sonic palette, including unusual instrumentation and contrasting timbres, along with its deeply expressive nature and sense of journey, are most valued by the public.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

Neste episódio do 'Feira Semanal', somos recebidos com generosidade transmontana e orgulho no que é local.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 66
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson with NHØP - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson gave a stunning performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: Fannie Mae
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Love Ballad
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: I Want Your Love
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Adjustment
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: The Blue Note Masters
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bill Laurance Project

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Jones Thad, A Child Is Born
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Fine and Mellow
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, Cuban pianist and vocalist Roberto Fonseca performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: Seven Steps to Heaven
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 55
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features undeafeated Andre Berto (25-0, 19 KOs) in his 4th defense of the WBC Welterweight Title as he takes on former WBO Champion Carlos 'El Indio' Quintana (27-2, 21 KOs) at the BankAtlantic Center in Sunrise, Florida, USA on April 10, 2010. .

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 48
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a heavyweight battle that ends in a curious decision between Jonathon Banks and Seth Mitchell , as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Juan Manuel Marquez vs. Juan Diaz with three lightweight titles on the line. This fight earned Fight of the Year honors from The Ring magazine. Also on the card, heavyweight kickboxing action.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T33 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 5 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan, features Kiribayama, Terunofuji, Mitakeumi and Daieisho.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 8

Bantamweight champion Dominick Cruz helps out with children's charities and feeding the hungry. Cage fighting veteran Frank Mir shows off his classic car and high tech hot rod collection and MMA legend Chuck Liddell unveils his life size wax statue.

programme.desc: Delphine, prof de lettres désabusée, a un deal bien rôdé avec ses élèves : ils lui fichent une paix royale, elle leur distribue des 19/20. Mais la combine se retourne contre elle quand ses excellents résultats (fictifs) propulsent sa classe au championnat du monde de latin, à Naples. Comble du cauchemar, c'est le neveu très zélé de la Proviseure qui est choisi comme accompagnateur.

programme.title: Gueule Cassée
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - Cycle 'Incorrigibles !' Un adolescent de 17 ans tombe sous l’emprise d’un influenceur masculiniste. Dans la salle de bain, qu’il partage avec sa soeur, il est prêt à tout pour reprendre sa place d’homme et éviter son « grand remplacement ».

programme.title: In Der Luft
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - Cycle 'Incorrigibles !' Au cœur de Sarreguemines, ancienne cité ouvrière située à la frontière franco-allemande, Hugo vit l’été de ses 16 ans entre son quartier et les friches industrielles de la ville. Quand il n’est pas juché sur ma mob débridée, le jeune adolescent trompe son manque d’assurance en s’improvisant leader de son trio de copains. Aujourd’hui, il vient de mettre la main sur un authentique pistolet.

programme.title: Le Livreur de Noël
programme.desc: Tandis qu’il attend l’arrivée de ses enfants pour fêter Noël, Julien, en CDD dans une entreprise de livraisons est contraint d’accepter un remplacement au dernier moment. Il promet à ses enfants de rentrer avant minuit et les confie à sa fantasque voisine Olga ! Entre une mauvaise fréquentation du passé qui ressurgit et des livraisons inattendues... le père de famille débute une tournée riche en aventures.

programme.title: La Passion de Dodin Bouffant
programme.desc: Au XIXe siècle, Eugénie est depuis 20 ans cuisinière au service du célèbre gastronome Dodin. A force de passer du temps ensemble dans la cuisine, une passion amoureuse s'est construite entre eux deux. Mais Eugénie n'a jamais voulu se marier avec Dodin, pour garder sa liberté.

programme.desc: Oups arrive dans la cuisine alors que Bisou est en train de faire la vaisselle. Oups prend un moule pour l’essuyer... et fait dégringoler l’égouttoir... et tout ce qui se trouvait sur le comptoir de la cuisine, dont le gâteau que Bisou venait de préparer ! Cette découverte de l’Outback vu du ciel permet de visiter une région emblématique et pourtant peu connue de l’Australie. En partie désertique, elle occupe une superficie équivalente à celle de la France.

programme.title: Survivre a l'hiver
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par BBC Studio. 2019. Réalisateur : Simon Baxter. Pour affronter les températures glaciales de l'hiver, les nuits sans fin et la pénurie de nourriture, les animaux adoptent différentes stratégies, comme l'écureuil qui stocke ses provisions dès l'automne ou encore les manchots qui se regroupent pour résister aux températures les plus froides du globe.

programme.title: Alentejo, le Portugal Authentique
programme.desc: Un film de Franck Decluzet Une production Ampersand. 2025 Entre ses plaines couvertes de chênes-lièges, ses villages médiévaux et son littoral encore sauvage, la région de l’Alentejo abrite une identité culturelle bien à elle. Ce voyage explore des traditions uniques comme la riziculture de Comporta, la vinification en jarres de terre cuite ou le chant polyphonique du Cante Alentejano.

Autour de lui, Blanche Leridon, essayiste et directrice éditoriale de l'institut Montaigne, et Raphaël Llorca, expert associé à la Fondation Jean-Jaurès, nous raconteront les aspirations, les craintes mais aussi les espoirs des Françaises et des Français durant cette campagne présidentielle historique.

L’objectif : décrypter les grands sujets contemporains afin de nous aider à mieux les comprendre.

programme.title: Sing 2
programme.desc: Buster Moon e seus amigos devem persuadir o recluso astro do rock Clay Calloway a se juntar a eles para a abertura de um novo show.

programme.title: Garfield: O Filme

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider - O Berço da Vida

programme.title: 007 Spectre

programme.title: Missão: Impossível - Ajuste de Contas Parte Um

programme.title: Noite em Fuga

programme.title: Vôo em Fúria
programme.desc: John é enviado para recuperar um bombardeiro Stealth roubado. O seu fiel companheiro Rojar e Jessica, sempre fiéis , irão lutar contra as forças rebeldes de Banansistan, lideradas por Ellianna o vivaz.

programme.title: Um Homem à Parte
programme.desc: Um polícia tenta vingar a morte da sua mulher que faleceu num atentado cometido por um traficante de droga.

programme.title: Assassino Americano
programme.desc: O gangster americano Erik Vasquez está a planear tornar-se o chefe do submundo mexicano, mas acaba por fazer inimigos tanto nos poderosos cartéis como nos seus próprios aliados.

programme.title: Renegados (2022)

programme.title: O Fiel Jardineiro

programme.title: Alvin E Os Esquilos: A Grande Aventura

programme.title: Nos Caminhos De Jesus - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em vários episódios, serão revisitados os caminhos que Jesus Cristo percorreu ao longo da sua vida, realçando em cada local, o contexto religioso, político e social da época.

programme.title: Informação Ao Minuto T3 - Ep. 104
programme.desc: É o espaço noticioso diário que leva até si, de forma clara e imediata, os acontecimentos que marcam a atualidade nacional e internacional. Com uma abordagem rigorosa e acessível, o programa cedido pela TV Maná 1 à Kuriakos TV, destaca os temas mais relevantes do momento — da política à economia, da sociedade à cultura — garantindo uma informação atualizada e de confiança.

programme.title: A Rota T10 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Cada Momento T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Beatriz, Tomás, Pedro, Teresa e Fred cresceram juntos, prometeram nunca se separar, mas não cumpriram a sua promessa. Uma morte inesperada leva-os a pensar o que os fez chegar àquele ponto. Há como voltar?.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Les escrocs n'ont peur de rien. Leurs victimes ne sont plus seulement de parfaits inconnus, ils s’attaquent aussi à leurs proches : conjoints, amis, amoureux, membres de la famille... Et les conséquences sont souvent dévastatrices. Il aurait arnaqué une quarantaine de femmes Près de Chartres, un homme est soupçonné d'avoir manipulé et dépouillé des dizaines de femmes rencontrées sur des sites de rencontre.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Foires : arnaques ou bonnes affaires ? Chaque année, 1 200 foires et salons sont organisés en France. Un succès à chaque fois : 230 000 exposants et près de 23 millions de visiteurs. L’objectif des clients : payer moins cher. Mais les prix sont-ils vraiment intéressants ? Cuisines, pergola, outils de jardinage, panneaux photovoltaïques : certains vendeurs vous forcent parfois la main… Et une fois acheté, impossible de se rétracter.

programme.desc: Deux adjoints du shérif se font tirer dessus par un indic, Arroyo, dans un entrepôt, mais les preuves balistiques ne corroborent pas cette version. programme.title: Anek
programme.desc: Madhu, an animator, gets thoughts about her past life, but her psychiatrist believes it to be a figment of her imagination. Madhu happens to meet Ashwin, the man she was in love with in her past life.

programme.title: Koi Jaane Na
programme.desc: A heartbroken writer struggling with writer's block goes to a hill station where he finds love again but uncovers a copycat serial killer who has mysteriously come alive.

programme.title: Bhaiyya Ji
programme.desc: A man stands up for his family and seeks revenge for the wrongs done towards his loved ones.

programme.title: Gulabo Sitabo
programme.desc: Two scheming men get caught up in a game of one-up-manship, each one attracting other members to their clan and each one with an agenda of his own.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
programme.desc: Raj, Pooja and Jhanvi are in a complicated love triangle. Pooja and Jhanvi love Raj. Raj loves Jhanvi but is misunderstood as Pooja's husband by their family. How will the confusion clear off?.

programme.title: Khandani Shafakhana
programme.desc: Babita Bedi working as a medical representative and the only earner in the house. She has to run a fertility clinic for six months in order to sell it or else she will lose everything.

programme.title: Setters
programme.desc: Apurva Chaudhary and his team leak several examination papers and make huge profits out of it. Meanwhile, Aditya Singh and his team of honest officers attempt to catch the criminals.

programme.title: Jalsa
programme.desc: It tells the story of a celebrated journalist and her cook and their conflict.

programme.title: Adbhut
programme.desc: Follows Diana who doesn't believe in supernatural power. But when she feels something strange happening on a regular basis, she reaches out to Nawaz for help.

programme.title: Haseen Dillruba
programme.desc: Under investigation as a suspect in her husband's murder, a wife reveals details of their thorny marriage that seem to only further blur the truth.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: The son of a wealthy, powerful industrialist returns to India and undergoes a remarkable transformation as he becomes consumed by a quest for vengeance against those threatening his father's life.

programme.title: An Action Hero
programme.desc: A murder accusation turns a movie star's own life into an eccentric action thriller as he flees the country, with a vengeful politician hot on his heels.

programme.title: Paagalpanti
programme.desc: A tourist group from India sets out on a vacation to only have their trip to turn into a patriotic mission. Will it end well for them?.

programme.title: Nehlle Pe Dehlla

programme.title: Virasat
programme.desc: Watch award-winning performances by Anil Kapoor and Tabu in this story of a dutiful son who sacrifices all his happiness to live his father's dream of developing his native village.

programme.title: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
programme.desc: A romantically inclined couple decide to get to know each other through letters without disclosing their identities.

programme.title: Dil Hai Ke Manta Nahi
programme.desc: Pooja runs away from home to be with her boyfriend. On her way, she meets Raghu, who agrees to escort her to her destination, and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Zara Hatke Zara Bachke
programme.desc: Kapil and Somya are a happily married couple who live in a joint family and decide to get a divorce. Things don't go as planned as their family gets to know of it, and thus begins a comedy of errors.

programme.title: Heyy Baby
programme.desc: Three men living in Australia are surprised to find a baby on their doorstep. They do not know who the father is and start a frantic search for the woman who could possibly be the mother.

programme.title: Poster Boyz
programme.desc: Three men face ridicule from their families and fellow villagers after they appear on a poster that promotes vasectomies. They soon embark on a mission to prove that they are victims of the system.
